title: Why Do Cuttlefish Change Color? 🦑 #Shorts
description:
Cuttlefish change color using millions of chromatophores — tiny pigment sacs in their skin that their brain controls like pixels.
So why do cuttlefish flash colors? To vanish into the seafloor, signal other cuttlefish, and warn off predators — all in under a second.

OTIS answers the wildest animal questions in under a minute.
